column1: # The test variants' findings: -Dsanitize-thread (ThreadSanitizer) and -Dmany-browsers (a second, busy
# Browser on another thread of every test process), lane tsan1, 2026-11-02, chat.local.
#   zig build test-launch -Dspec=<s> -Dsanitize-thread      s = dom, html (tree: main c920187b119 + the lane)
#   zig build test-launch -Dspec=<s> -Dmany-browsers        s = websocket, service_worker, html, dom, v8
# Every test of each suite ran at batch 1 (suite_configs); each non-pass was re-run alone twice (runs = first + alone).
# Clean: tests-dom under both variants (one TSAN timeout of a 30 s test, fixed by the TSAN timeout factor),
#        tests-websocket 55/55, tests-service_worker 118/118, tests-dom 642/642 beside the busy Browser.
# Found: tests-html under TSAN 2,244 pass, 7 FAIL, 10 FLAKY (F1, F2, F3, T1); tests-html beside the busy
#        Browser 2,260 pass, 1 FLAKY, and on the merged tip (main e010fa8b324) 2,265 pass, 1 FAIL, 1 FLAKY (M2); tests-v8 beside the busy Browser 1,624 pass, 8 skip, 12 FAIL, 19 FLAKY
